# UX Checklist: Diseño profesional y navegación por barras

**Purpose**: Validar la calidad (completitud, claridad, consistencia, medibilidad) de los requisitos de UX/UI antes de implementar.
**Created**: 2026-10-31
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are the position, content and order of the navigation bar elements (name, four sections) fully specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [x] CHK002 Are requirements defined for how the navigation bar behaves on narrow screens (wrap, scroll, collapse)? [Gap, Spec §FR-001, §FR-010]
- [x] CHK003 Are keyboard navigation and focus order requirements defined for the navigation bar and all interactive elements? [Gap, Accessibility]
- [x] CHK004 Are the exact Spanish texts for each empty-list guidance defined for every list (servicios, clientes, líneas del presupuesto)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009]
- [x] CHK005 Are requirements defined for the confirmation of destructive actions (eliminar) beyond button color? [Gap, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK006 Are disabled-state requirements defined for buttons (e.g., Descargar PDF without lines)? [Gap]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK007 Is "se ve profesional" translated into concrete, objectively reviewable visual properties? [Ambiguity, Spec §Objetivo]
- [x] CHK008 Is "contraste suficiente" quantified with a measurable threshold? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK009 Is "destacarse visualmente" for the final total defined with measurable properties (size, weight, color)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK010 Are the palette, typography and spacing scale defined, or explicitly delegated to the plan? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK011 Is "cerca de la acción que los origina" defined with a concrete placement rule for messages? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-007]
- [x] CHK012 Is "acciones alineadas" in tables defined (which column, which alignment)? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-005]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK013 Are hover, focus and active state requirements consistent across navigation links, buttons and fields? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002, §FR-004]
- [x] CHK014 Are button-level requirements (principal/secundario/eliminación) consistent with which actions each screen assigns to each level? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK015 Do the success criteria (SC-001..005) each trace to at least one functional requirement? [Traceability]
- [x] CHK016 Is the "no changes to PDF/calculations" constraint consistent with the requirement to emphasize the total on screen? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008, §FR-012]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK017 Can "estilo uniforme" be objectively verified by a non-technical reviewer, with a defined list of elements to compare? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [x] CHK018 Is "sin contenido cortado" at 360 px defined for every screen, including long names and the logo? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]
- [x] CHK019 Is "identifica a simple vista" for the active section defined with a verifiable criterion? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK020 Are requirements defined for very long text (nombres, descripciones) and large logos? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK021 Are requirements specified for screens wider than typical desktop (maximum content width)? [Gap]
- [x] CHK022 Are error-state requirements defined for fields with invalid input (visual marking of the field itself)? [Gap, Spec §FR-007]
- [x] CHK023 Is the behavior defined when the logo is missing or fails to display? [Gap]

## Non-Functional & Assumptions

- [x] CHK024 Are accessibility requirements beyond contrast (focus visibility, labels, text size) specified? [Gap, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK025 Is the list of supported browsers/viewports documented as an assumption? [Assumption, Gap]
- [x] CHK026 Is the exclusion of dark mode and animations stated and consistent with the rest of the spec? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]

## Findings

Todos los huecos se resolvieron en spec.md (FR-013..018, FR-002/005/007/008/011, Assumptions), plan.md, research.md, contracts/ui-components.md y tasks.md. Revisado con asistencia; el revisor puede reabrir cualquier item.

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
